##: The manifest for the author's bucket, https://github.com/ruslan-rv-ua/scoop-bucket. This
copy is the seed: it goes into the bucket as bucket/revisor.json once, by hand, after the
first release (the Backlog document «Випуск релізу»), with the real hash from that
release's .sha256 in place of the zeros below. From then on the bucket's own Excavator
bumps the bucket's copy from the checkver and autoupdate fields; nothing bumps this one.
The '#/revisor.exe' fragment renames the download, so 'bin' and the shortcut stay the same
across versions while the release file keeps its version in its name. scoop strips the
A GUI exe needs nothing special: scoop makes the shim a GUI program when its target is
one, so starting revisor from PATH flashes no console. 'shortcuts' adds 'revisor' to the
revisor keeps everything it writes in a 'data' folder beside its exe. 'persist' links
<app>\data to ~\scoop\persist\revisor\data with a junction, so settings, profiles and
snapshots survive 'scoop update' and 'scoop uninstall' without --purge.
autoupdate takes the hash from the release's .sha256 sidecar: '$url' there is the download
URL without its '#/' fragment, so '$url.sha256' is the sidecar beside the exe, and its
'<hex64> *<name>' line is what scoop's hash extraction reads.
